description: This file contains assembly implementations of standard string manipulation functions such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, backwards_memcpy, memchr, memcmp, and related cache management routines. It is targeted at PowerPC architecture and appears to be part of low-level system initialization or bootloader code.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to a specified number of characters from source to destination, null-terminating if the source is shorter than the limit.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates source string to the end of the destination string.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Locates the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to a specified number of characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specified byte value.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory area, handling overlapping regions safely.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies a block of memory from source to destination.

methods.name: backwards_memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory backwards, used for overlapping regions from the end.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Locates the first occurrence of a byte in a memory block.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes data cache and invalidates instruction cache over a range of addresses.
